content: The autonomous-task-brain skill follows a fixed 5-stage closed-loop autonomous task workflow: 1) Perceive (scan recent sessions to identify new, repeated, or failed tasks), 2) Retrieve (query local skills, historical sessions, memory engines, and GitHub for optimal solutions), 3) Decide (select execute/suggest/skip actions based on historical success rate, task complexity, and user preferences), 4) Execute (auto create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks), 5) Review (record execution results and update the knowledge base for future optimization).
